note: Engine profiles for the engine-fit classifier (ROADMAP.md phase A). Verdict vocabulary matches the tried-options ledger: ADOPT / REJ / PARKED / CLOSED. Content verified against research/engines.md (fresh fetches 2026-10-23). The classifier never recommends an engine the ledger rejected without citing its reopen trigger; where research and the ledger disagree, both are recorded and the ledger rule wins for THIS hardware.

sglang-hybrid.label: SGLang + kt-kernel hybrid (this project's reference engine)
sglang-hybrid.what_it_is: upstream SGLang serving deepseek_v41 with kt-kernel computing the CPU-resident experts; 61-patch overlay + 3 kt patches + Engram file layout. Upstream SGLang added Paged Experts (merged 2026-10-19): K-of-E GPU residency with auto-K sized from safetensors headers + mem-fraction + KV reserve - the engine-side budget-to-placement loop, a calibration point for our K math.
sglang-hybrid.placement_model: GPU-resident experts + CPU-computed DRAM experts + Engram on NVMe/DRAM; hot-expert map (static, 10-15% CPU-share floor; T3.8d runtime placement now measured at 1.8-2.2% held-out share); deferral D<=4; streamed prefill; HiCache KV offload tiers available upstream
sglang-hybrid.serves_shape: CPU-hybrid MoE that does not fit VRAM
sglang-hybrid.runtime_placement: upstream Paged Experts PR #42557; local T3.8d in progress (a6c5b82)

llama-cpp.label: llama.cpp / llama-server
llama-cpp.what_it_is: the universal local-inference engine; -ot regex tensor offload, MoE offload, draft --moe-expert-cache LRU
llama-cpp.placement_model: GPU/CPU tensor split (-ngl, -ot, --n-cpu-moe, --fit); mmap; no NVMe tier for weights; KV is GPU-only
llama-cpp.verdict: ADOPT for the small-model tier; deepseek41/CSA2 route PARKED on upstream (ggml-org/llama.cpp#28696)
llama-cpp.calibration_anchor: published (Hardware Corner via smeltcore.com): Qwen3-30B-A3B 226.1 tok/s on 5090 / 153.6 on 3090

vllm.label: vLLM
vllm.what_it_is: the reference GPU-resident server; v0.31 adds weight offload (--cpu-offload-gb/--cpu-offload-params, UVA backend), per-component Engram host offload, and KV tiering (CPU + persistent filesystem, TieringOffloadingSpec); owns the recipes schema rendered at recipes.vllm.ai
vllm.placement_model: GPU-resident + optional named-parameter CPU offload (UVA) + KV tiering to CPU/filesystem; EPLB for expert packing; placement is author-planned per recipe YAML, not budget-computed
vllm.serves_shape: GPU-resident or lightly-offloaded models; secondary CPU-hybrid tier
vllm.verdict: ADOPT as schema/provenance source + GPU-resident tier + secondary CPU-hybrid tier; not the primary hybrid engine (no routing-aware CPU compute tier)
vllm.calibration_anchor: none yet in this repo (V4-Flash NVFP4 baseline was vLLM: 171-239 tok/s C1, E8)

tensorfold.label: TensorFold (EXL3 recipe engine)
tensorfold.what_it_is: single Zig binary (Metal + CUDA), no Python at serve time; EXL3/TR3/EXLR8/MLX/NVFP4 recipes, revision-pinned model pulls, memory-floor reporting, portable benchmark receipts; DeepSeek checkpoints not served yet (whole-model gate #827 open)
tensorfold.placement_model: quant-shrunk single/paired-machine; no CPU/NVMe weight offload; prompt-cache/learn disk tiers
tensorfold.serves_shape: models that fit only after aggressive quantization
tensorfold.verdict: REJ as engine on THIS hardware (ledger T3.32: same-model TP4 builds 12-24% behind SGLang) - the ledger rule wins over research's tier-level ADOPT. Reopen trigger: DeepSeek support lands (#827) or a published SM120 EXL3 MoE kernel with a KL number. Borrow now: pin-and-floor conventions, receipt culture, per-layer bit-allocation recipe shape

deepinfer.label: DeepSeek DeepInfer
deepinfer.what_it_is: DeepSeek's production inference runtime, open-sourced 2026-10-16 (NOT deprecated - the repo did not exist before); Apache-2.0, ~21k stars, built primarily on vLLM; offline inference only for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (default checkpoint is 1017); no KV-cache system or VE/Prefill/Decode disaggregation yet; SM100 + Ascend 950 only
deepinfer.placement_model: Attention DP / balanced CP, MoE EP + EPLB (step_peak policy, being ported to ROCm/ATOM #2673); no CPU/NVMe offload; hand-authored per deployment
deepinfer.serves_shape: multi-GPU EP at V4.x datacenter scale
deepinfer.verdict: ADOPT as the multi-GPU-EP reference tier (watch) - offline-only and SM100/Ascend today, so not runnable on this SM120 box; borrow its batch-invariance + deterministic-sampling gates into our qualification suite. Reopen: a server/KV/disaggregation release promotes it to a primary tier

flare.label: NVIDIA FLARE
flare.what_it_is: Federated Learning Application Runtime Environment (NVIDIA/NVFlare, Apache-2.0, active): FedAvg/FedProx/FedOpt/Scaffold training orchestration, scatter-and-gather workflows, differential privacy / homomorphic encryption / PSI, simulator + dashboard + authorization
flare.placement_model: none - schedules training jobs across sites; no checkpoint-component, VRAM/DRAM/NVMe, or serving concepts
flare.serves_shape: nothing single-box; the only imaginable use is fleet recipe governance (roll out recipe revisions, collect per-host gate results) - and its aggregation/privacy machinery would be dead weight there; plain orchestration wins
flare.verdict: REJ as engine, CLOSED. Reopen trigger: a real multi-host governance requirement appears - evaluate plain orchestration first
